responses.raw_text:
I understand what you're saying; however, the double-edged sword of AI is in the matter that it "mainstreams" the ability to make modifications to photos / videos.

The level of effort of editing photos and videos being hard was similar to having expensive cameras.

Ultimately, in the age we're in, AI may lead towards a place where no one trust ANY photo / video. However, while AI is almost at that stage in terms of capability, people are not at that stage of understanding (yet).

With all that said, I have noted your point and will add it to the graph I'm making.
